01 — About the firm

A specialist in structures that need to last.

Founded on hands-on site experience, not just paperwork — every project below is run the same way.

VMAK Construction and Repair is a leading player in the construction industry, offering a comprehensive range of services including waterproofing, retrofitting, construction, and repairs. With a commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction, we deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

  • MissionTo deliver high-quality services that exceed client expectations, build long-term relationships, foster innovation, and contribute to the growth of the construction industry.
  • QualityUncompromising commitment to excellence in materials, method, and finish.
  • SafetyPrioritizing the well-being of our team, clients, and the environment on every site.
  • IntegrityTransparency, honesty, and ethics in all our dealings.
  • InnovationEmbracing new technologies and techniques to stay ahead.

Waterproofing

Cutting-edge solutions to protect your assets from water damage — brick-bat coba, OHWT treatment, elastomeric coatings and swimming-pool systems.

Retrofitting

Upgrading existing structures to enhance durability, safety, and functionality, including shear-wall and slab retrofitting.

Construction

Turnkey projects for residential, commercial, and industrial clients — from RCC to compound walls.

Repairs

Timely, effective structural maintenance that extends the lifespan of your assets.

Why clients choose VMAK

  • Experienced team with a proven track record
  • State-of-the-art equipment and techniques
  • Competitive pricing without compromising quality
  • Timely completion of projects
  • Personalized service and attention to detail
